newsitem.title: USA: W.House's Hilley - US budget details near finished.
newsitem.headline: W.House's Hilley - US budget details near finished.

text.p: White House Legislative Director John Hilley, who briefed Democrat lawmakers on efforts to iron out differences with congressional budget negotiators, said Wednesday the process was nearly completed.
"We hope to finish today," Hilley told reporters.
Agreement was reached that there would be two separate reconciliation bills to allow for separate votes on spending and taxes, Hilley said.
Budget negotiators are working on putting together a budget resolution, which is a framework that congressional budget committees are expected to take up for consideration Thursday.
Once the budget plan is passed, Congress must pass separate legislation known as reconciliation to enact the details of the budget.
House Speaker Newt Gingrich of Georgia and Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott of Mississippi are expected to send President Clinton a letter outlining agreements reached on taxes.
Hilley, asked what the letter would say, replied: "It will be true to the agreement announced on Friday," May 2.
Asked whether it would assure the White House that the president's proposed tax credits for higher education would be included in the budget, Hilley said it would.
